questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

7, 21, 35, ?, 63
questions.solution:
**Logic :** (14) is added to each number subsequently.

So,

7 + 14 = 21

21 + 14 = 35

35 + 14 = **49**

**49** + 14 = 63

Hence, **"49"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

STATEMENTS:

A. All boxes are pans.

B. Some boxes are jugs.

C. Some jugs are glasses.

CONCLUSIONS:

I. Some glasses are boxes.

II. No glass is a box.

III. Some jugs are pans.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d6ddaed44946228c42ba91337015b48c8e47c7e881a6fd0ae2bcecd3fb79f8e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some glasses are boxes → **Does not** Follow (As, some boxes are jugs and some jugs are glasses. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

II. No glass is a box → **Does not **Follow (As, some boxes are jugs and some jugs are glasses. So, no direct or negative relation is given between boxes and glasses therefore it is definitely false.)

III. Some jugs are pans → Follow (As, all boxes are pans and some boxes are jugs. So, as whole boxers comes in pans and have some part common with jugs therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion III follows**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__** 

There is conclusion I and II follows either or case but no such option is given in the question. So, it can not be the correct choice.

questions.question: 8 friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A is the immediate neighbour of B and C. H is the immediate neighbour of F and G. D is sitting to the immediate left of B. E is sitting to the immediate right of C. A and H are sitting opposite each other. Who is sitting immediate right of B?
questions.solution:
**Given : **8 friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

**Explanation : **

1) A is the immediate neighbour of B and C.

2) D is sitting to the immediate left of B.

3) E is sitting to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed316ea4510fd78d659bbdf9784132314c11fe5f1b877a682e70616cd5b7183a.png] 

4) H is the immediate neighbour of F and G.

5) A and H are sitting opposite each other.

As position of F and G is not known with respect to H, therefore there are two possible positions for F and G.

After positioning F, G and H only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad6e4cb24192870baffdedddb8f092d3ce8cc7f836f7b1c92f5b12b8a67507ad.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement A is sitting immediate right of B.

Hence, **"A"** is the correct answer.

questions.solution:
**Logic :** Term : Antonym 

So,

__
 
• **Slavery** antonym is **liberty**.

Similarly,

 
• **Hate **antonym is **love**.

Hence **"Love"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Marriage → Antonyms are divorce, separated and disunited.

• Love → antonyms are hate and dislike.
